method: Real research_evidence API on a private 100-source ledger, 100 exclusions, 256 candidates and ten 64KiB source documents. ABBA process order per platform, five trials of twenty calls per mode per process. Source pages, detail, reexcerpted pages, candidates and exclusions. Includes native filesystem reads, JSON parsing and response construction; excludes fixture setup and output equality serialization. All response hashes match. Warm OS file cache, shared host; requested C++ allocation bytes are not peak RAM. No network or model timing.
